title: Derive the macOS Test-arm needle in test/ci-workflow.test.ts from the matrix label
description: Review finding 1 on lore-cli#700 (Opus reviewer lore-cli-review-776, claude-opus-5-5, APPROVE at b8da22cd). test/ci-workflow.test.ts:81 and :181 each hard-code the macOS label separately, so nothing ties the matrix label to the Test arm's == macos-15 branch at ci.yml:336. Failure scenario: a later label move updates the matrix and line 81 but misses ci.yml:336; both tests stay green and the macOS leg falls through to the bare else arm (ci.yml:404-405, bun test --isolate --timeout=10000) with no silence guard or sample, back to dying at the 20-minute job cancel. Pre-existing gap. Fix: derive the arm needle from the matrix value in the test. ci.yml is a DEC-182 floor path, so the fix needs the leader's dispatch-floor brief.
